name: hzcrh4-cancel-verified-build
goal: Cancelling a verified artifact build stops its owned process tree, releases admission, and removes the source snapshot.

evidence: An admitted setup starts a child. Cancelling verification must stop that child and remove its exact-commit snapshot.

The retained-output case verifies success and a missing file. The SDK fixture checked pre-abort only. The snapshot case now waits on a real setup descendant, then checks child exit and snapshot teardown.
Exact snapshot regression failed with descendant and snapshot still present. Recorded on harbor-mbp-2.
An admitted verification process propagates cancellation to its checks and preserves its Bun signal handler.
The unchanged regression passed on harbor-mbp-2. The packaged CLI separately passed cleanup from the real Node SDK.
